scenarios.title: Commit and push as one plain command per call
scenarios.prompt: You are on the branch `feature/42-export-csv` for ticket #42. You changed `src/export.ts` and `src/export.spec.ts`. Stage them, commit with a message that explains the change, push the branch, then open the draft pull request.

scenarios.title: Delegation consent was never asked
scenarios.prompt: `sf status --agent-friendly --no-network` prints `delegation: not-asked`. This is the first ticket of the session: #42, complexity medium, plan approved. Start it.

scenarios.title: A trivial change is built in a worktree of its own
scenarios.prompt: `delegation: allowed`. Ticket #51 is a typo in the README, one line in one file. You are the session, and the primary checkout is on the working branch `develop`. Start the work.

scenarios.title: The current agent is not declared in the project
scenarios.prompt: The host tells you that you are running as Kimi Code. Start the session.

scenarios.title: A failed precondition is routed, not worked around
scenarios.prompt: `sf status --agent-friendly --no-network` reports a precondition as `fail`: no GitHub Projects board is attached to the workflow. The developer asks you to create a ticket for a new feature.

scenarios.title: The remote is unreachable: stop and report
scenarios.prompt: `git push origin feature/42-export-csv` just failed with `Could not resolve host: github.com`. Three commits for ticket #42 exist only locally.

scenarios.title: A failed route is never worked around with another agent's CLI
scenarios.prompt: `delegation: allowed`. You ran `sf agents route --task multi-file-feature --provider claude-code --ticket 42 --record` and it failed with a non-zero exit code. How do you proceed with ticket #42?
